chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from his father ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who forgets to begin the salat (prayer) until he bows in rukuʿ. He said: He must repeat the salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: the Imam addressed with this kunyah
key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to bow in rukuʿ during the salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَفْتَتِحَ: to commence the salat (prayer), here meaning to begin it with the opening takbir
key_terms.يَنْسَى: forgets; fails to remember an obligatory element

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Takbīrat al-Iftitāḥ until going into rukuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the opening takbir of salat (prayer) until reaching rukuʿ. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام rules that the salat (prayer) must be repeated, indicating the essential nature of the prayer’s opening.
